summary: The evidence does not support an incident. No log removal, no policy-violating transfer and no data staging was found, and there were no collection gaps. Three benign findings were verified and kept by the skeptic: (1) F-9536d6: lines missing from the records access.log all predate the 08:53 scheduled rotation (keep=0, archived off-host), and the collector holds them. (2) F-8e841c: ~11.6MB immunization-registry submission from the workstation to approved lab-gw-01 10.20.8.20:80 at 10:07, during a console session using the aokafor account. (3) F-7b726a: ~21MB rsync from records to approved backup NAS 10.20.0.45:873 at 11:58, with no interactive session. Attribution: the aokafor account was used; the human operator is not established.
